title: Central Park Movie Locations Pedicab Tour
blurb:
Explore Central Park like never before on this unique pedicab tour that showcases famous filming locations from beloved movies such as Home Alone 2, Elf, and Avengers. Glide through the park as your knowledgeable guide shares entertaining stories and behind-the-scenes insights while you watch clips from the films shot at each stop. Capture the magic at iconic spots like Gapstow Bridge, Bethesda Fountain, Bow Bridge, The Mall, and Strawberry Fields, where cinematic history comes alive. Perfect for movie buffs and families alike, this tour invites you to snap photos and relive cherished film moments in a picturesque setting.

- Discover real-life movie locations in Central Park
- Comfortable pedicab ride with an expert guide
- Visit iconic spots like Bethesda Fountain and Bow Bridge
- Fun for film lovers and families, great photo opportunities
